summary: The core architecture contracts in CLAUDE.md, the COMPANY_AUDIT_LIVE_SOURCES doc, and the v4 gate manifest are largely faithful to the running system: all 18 gate names Q00–Q17 match the active manifest exactly, all 14 spot-checked tool paths exist, the gemini lane genuinely executes via the agy CLI (gemini-cli is dead in code), the headless Claude lane genuinely runs Sonnet, and the quota-governor/agy-governor throttle flags are present and behaving as documented. Three material drifts exist. (1) HIGH: CLAUDE.md's reboot-recovery instruction points operators to QM_StrategyFarm_TerminalWorkers_AT_STARTUP, which is Disabled; workers now come up via QM_StrategyFarm_FactoryON_AtLogon (Factory_ON.ps1). (2) MEDIUM: docs say the tester cache purge uses LowWater 150 GB, but the live task runs -LowWaterGB 60. (3) MEDIUM: CLAUDE.md describes agy/Antigravity as research-only, but the live registry and the orchestration prompt still grant the gemini lane code/tests/repo_edit and explicitly allow it to draft code. Several live mechanisms are undocumented in CLAUDE.md: the agent_chain cross-vendor critique sweep (OWNER 2026-09-15), the codex_budget_line + codex_fleet_pacer weekly pacer (OWNER 2026-09-13), quota_pull.py, the Codex model-tier ladder (sol/terra/luna, observe mode), and several dry-run/watchdog tasks. Runtime health note: agy quota auth is currently expired (HTTP 401) and several daily tasks show non-zero LastTaskResult.

risks: Reboot-recovery drift (HIGH): an operator following CLAUDE.md after a VPS reboot would inspect/re-enable QM_StrategyFarm_TerminalWorkers_AT_STARTUP (Disabled) and could conclude the factory is broken, or miss that recovery now runs through Factory_ON.ps1 via QM_StrategyFarm_FactoryON_AtLogon — wrong mental model during an outage.

tester_cache_purge LowWater is 60 GB live vs 150 GB documented: disk-pressure behaviour is far more permissive than the runbook claims; an operator sizing D: headroom off the doc would misjudge when purges kick in.

agy/gemini lane still carries code/tests/repo_edit in the live registry despite the doc + memory ('agy=NUR BACKUP, halluziniert') treating it as research-only; a code ticket could still route to the weakest seat if capability routing selects it, and the code comment confirms this is an unresolved OWNER decision, not an intended state.
agy research lane is effectively degraded right now: OAuth token expired (401), AGY_LOW_QUOTA.flag set — research throughput is paused, which the static docs do not surface.

Undocumented control-plane mechanisms (agent_chain critique sweep, codex budget line/fleet pacer, quota_pull, Codex model-tier ladder in 'observe' mode) mean a new session reading only CLAUDE.md would not know these are actively spawning agents/critics and pacing spend.
unknowns: Exact meaning of LastTaskResult 2147946720 on the Running Cockpit_2min and Pump_5min tasks — reported as a prior-run error code but not decoded; these tasks are currently in State=Running so the code may be stale.

Whether the several daily tasks with non-zero LastTaskResult (QM_NewsCalendar_Refresh=1, QM_StrategyFarm_MailboxSourceIntake_Daily=1, QM_Public_Snapshot_Hourly=1, QM_EvidenceCohortWatch_Daily_0420=3, QM_WorkItemLogPruner_Daily_0310=1) are persistent failures or transient — not investigated in depth (outside architecture-drift scope).

Whether QM_StrategyFarm_QuotaPull (quota_pull.py) and the GovernorDryRunWatch / Q10Breaker_DryRun watchers have any doc coverage elsewhere in docs/ops — only their scheduled-task actions were confirmed, not searched across all runbooks.
